findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document access
findings.body: When `userTenant !== documentTenant`, `canReadDocument` now returns `true`, allowing cross-tenant document reads. This removes the function’s existing authorization boundary and can expose tenant data.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document access
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now grants access for every input. Whenever `userTenant !== documentTenant`, callers relying on this authorization check will allow cross-tenant document reads, breaking tenant isolation and exposing data.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in `canReadDocument`
findings.body:
The authorization function now permits every read. Any caller using it as the document-read gate will authorize a user whose `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant`, exposing documents across tenant boundaries.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
